name: Instagram Carousel Generator
description: AI-powered Instagram carousel generator with intelligent image sourcing, editing, and composition. Analyzes successful carousels to determine optimal image strategies.

quota.description: Unlimited carousel generation for internal team
10 carousel generations per month for authenticated clients
Not available as public lead magnet

notes: Costs vary based on AI image strategy decisions
Advanced mode allows cost preview before generation

features.name: Intelligent Image Strategy
features.description: AI analyzes successful Instagram carousels to determine whether each slide should be generated, downloaded, edited, or composed from multiple sources

features.name: Instagram Research Engine
features.description: Scrapes and analyzes top-performing carousels in user's industry using Firecrawl

features.name: Multi-Source Image Acquisition
features.description: Downloads images from Google Image Search, Unsplash, Pexels, or user's brand assets

features.name: Nano Banana Editing
features.description: Uses Google Gemini 2.5 Flash Image to edit downloaded photos with natural language instructions

features.name: Multi-Image Composition
features.description: Combines multiple images (screenshots, brand templates, stock photos) into cohesive slides

features.name: Business Brain Personalization
features.description: Injects brand voice, industry context, target audience, and key facts into all content

features.name: Simple/Advanced Modes
features.description: Simple: fully automatic. Advanced: review/modify AI strategy before generation

features.name: Style Templates
features.description: Educational, promotional, storytelling, or statistical carousel formats

features.name: Export Options
features.description: Download individual PNGs, ZIP archive, Canva-compatible JSON

features.name: Slide Regeneration
features.description: Regenerate individual slides without recreating entire carousel

features.name: Historical Library
features.description: View past carousels, reuse successful templates
